    Kobre Gear-Tooth¶

    [!INFO] To the Tooth — Homunculi Do Not Approximate The machine-true measure of Kobre — one tooth, one truth. Forged by Homunculi hobbers to 0.02 mm, meshed like a purse of Kobran Gear.

    Base Units¶

    The Gear-Tooth is the only measure on Ge'or defined by interference. A Kobran Gear-shaped disc of hard steel, teeth count = denomination, must mesh. If it jams, it is false. The master Gear-Tooth — 2.117 mm pitch — is a platinum-iridium gear kept in oil at the Homunculi capital, hobbed on a water-powered hobber whose lead screw is itself certified to the Tooth. Every gear on Kobre is a ruler.

    Domain Unit Relation Notes
    Length (precision) Tooth base the Tooth — 2.117 mm. One gear-tooth pitch. Tolerance ±0.02 mm
    Gear 12 Teeth 25.4 mm — 1 Inch exactly. Homunculi set the Inch to 12 Teeth as diplomacy
    Hand 4 Gears 101.6 mm — 4 Inches
    Rod 10 Hands 1.016 m — machine rod
    Chain 10 Rods 10.16 m — shop chain
    Span 10 Chains 101.6 m — factory floor span
    Coarse Length Stone 28 cm borrowed from Dwarven Stone — 132.27 Teeth. Honored, not redefined
    Delve 2.8 km as dwarven — for mining correspondence
    Weight Grain base as Erisian
    Pennyweight 24 Grains assay
    Tooth-weight 12 Grains micro-weight — 0.777 g. One Tooth of platinum
    Gear-weight 12 Tooth-weights 9.33 g
    Hand-weight 8 Gear-weights 74.6 g
    Pound 6 Hand-weights 447.6 g — Kobre Pound, lighter (efficiency!)
    Stone 14 Pounds 6.27 kg
    Gear-Ton 1,000 Pounds 447.6 kg — metric-adjacent — Homunculi love 1,000s, dwarves forgive them
    Volume Tooth-cup base 25.4 mL — 1 Gear of water
    Pint 20 Tooth-cups 508 mL
    Gallon 8 Pints 4.06 L

    Workshop chant: Twelve teeth the gear, twelve gears the hand — mesh and you are true, jam and you are damned.

    The Coalsteel furnaces and Diamonds presses both stock Homunculi-calibrated Tooth gauges — a Kobre gauge that does not mesh in a Coalsteel gear is returned with a polite note and a dead homunculus's apprenticeship revoked.

    Who Uses¶

    All Kobre (4) — Homunculi, Coalsteel, Diamonds, Elf Kingdom (elven exiles who adopted the Tooth for trade). Also smiths at Kutten's Malbodor who import Kobre steel and love the Tooth for blade tolerances. Engineers anywhere who have tasted precision refuse to go back.

    A favorite of engineers — they literally use Kobran Gear as gears and gauges in a pinch. A purse that meshes is a ruler.

    Conversion Notes¶

    • To Erisian Standard: 1 Tooth = 0.0833 Erisian Inches — by design, 12 Teeth = 1.000 Erisian Inches exactly (Homunculi diplomacy). 1 Kobre Rod (1.016 m) = 3.333 Erisian Feet = 1.111 Erisian Yards. 1 Chain = 11.11 Erisian Yards.
    • To Dwarven Stone: 1 Stone = 132.27 Teeth — catalogue lists 132 Teeth + 0.27 filed. Dwarves list Homunculi parts in Stones; Homunculi list dwarven parts in Teeth. Both correct. 1 Dwarven Stone-Foot (29.4 cm) = 138.9 Teeth.
    • To Vennerian Cable: 1 Cable (185.2 m) = 87,475 Teeth. Vennerian purchase orders for Kobre gears are quoted in Teeth; Vennerian riggers convert to Cables for deck storage and pretend they understand.
    • To Lumina/Marti/Demon: Rare direct; all convert via Erisian or Dwarven. Kobre tolerance (0.02 mm) shames all others — a Kobre contract specifies jam test, not paper tolerance.
    • Romanium: Romanium on Kobre is weighed in Tooth-weights — 1 Tooth-weight = 0.777 g. Homunculi assay Romanium to the Tooth and price it in Kobran Gear teeth-count; a 48-tooth Gear of Romanium is a fortune that meshes.

    Flavor¶

    Kobre measure is religious precision as craft. A homunculus apprentice spends a year filing a single master Tooth before they are allowed to touch a customer's gear. To be off by a Tooth is idiom for catastrophic failure — literally one tooth's error will jam an engine and kill a crew. Children are given a 12-tooth Gear to play with; when they can stack twelve and spin the top freely, they are ready for numbers.

    Humans who visit Homunculi workshops expect noise; they find silence and oil and a gear spinning so true it hums. The foreman does not shout measurements — they show you the jam.

    Elves of Elf Kingdom adore the Tooth's honesty and deploy it alongside the Leaf without contradiction: the Leaf for living, the Tooth for making.
